welcomeEmail.subject: Welcome to StayXI — Your stay starts here 🌴
welcomeEmail.body:
Hi there!

Welcome to your vacation rental! We're so excited to have you stay with us.

Before you arrive, here's everything you need to know:

• Gate code: [GATE_CODE]
• WiFi network: [WIFI_NETWORK]
• WiFi password: [WIFI_PASSWORD]
• Checkout time: 10:00 AM
• Trash day: Bins go out Monday night
• Pool heater: Grey panel on lanai wall — press HEAT, set to 86°

We've also included a welcome card at the property with these details physically.

If you have any questions before or during your stay, just text us — we're here to help!

Enjoy your stay!

Best regards,
StayXI Team

checkoutReminderEmail.subject: Checkout reminder — Tomorrow is departure day 🏠
checkoutReminderEmail.body:
Hi!

Just a friendly reminder that checkout is tomorrow at 10:00 AM.

Please remember:
• Return keys to the box by the front door
• Strip the beds (or we'll do it for you)
• Take trash to the curb if your pickup is tomorrow
• Leave the AC at 78° while you're away

Have a safe trip home! We hope you had a wonderful stay.

StayXI Team

emergencyContactEmail.subject: We're here if you need us — Host contact info
emergencyContactEmail.body:
Hi!

If anything comes up during your stay, we're just a text away.

• For immediate issues: Text us anytime
• For non-urgent questions: We'll reply within a few hours
• If we don't respond quickly: Call the host directly at [HOST_PHONE]

We want your stay to be perfect, but we understand things come up.

StayXI

feedbackRequestEmail.subject: How was your stay? 🌟
feedbackRequestEmail.body:
Hi!

We hope you had a wonderful stay!

We'd love to hear your feedback — what did you love, and what could we improve?

Just reply to this message or text us any time.

Thanks for choosing StayXI!

— The Team
